# Nomos Open-Core

> Agents guess; Git cannot. Zero-token AST and Git guardrails powered by your coding agent - initialized once so ~4ms security hooks, 42 polyglot AST gates, and brownfield debt ratchets run invisibly underneath normal feature-branch workflows.

- **License:** Apache-2.0
- **Repository:** https://github.com/mgantlett/nomos
- **Agent Skill & Plugin Bootstrapper:** `npx skills add mgantlett/nomos` (`skills/nomos/SKILL.md`, `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`)
- **Documentation:** https://sophialabs.ca/docs/introduction
- **Full Documentation Corpus:** https://sophialabs.ca/llms-full.txt
- **Engineering Handbook (12 Chapters):** https://sophialabs.ca/handbook
- **Architecture Specifications (37):** https://sophialabs.ca/docs/specs
- **Empirical Field Dispatches:** https://sophialabs.ca/dispatches

## Where Nomos Sits in the Stack

```text
Human Developer -> Same plain-English prompts, same IDE, normal feat/* PRs (0 new commands to learn)
  |
Coding Agent    -> Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Windsurf, Aider
  |
Nomos Harness   -> Invisible ~4ms pre-tool airlock + 42 AST pre-commit gates + Day-0 debt ratchet
  |
Git Repository  -> main stays read-only & verified; broken shortcuts fail closed before commit
```

## Autonomous Agent Day-0 Setup Protocol (When Asked to Set Up Nomos)

When a developer asks an AI coding agent to install or configure Nomos in their repository, follow these 4 rules:

1. **Install Static Binary:** Run `curl -fsSL https://sophialabs.ca/install | bash` (Linux/macOS/WSL2) or `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto CGO_ENABLED=0 go install github.com/mgantlett/nomos/substrate/cmd/nomos@latest`.
2. **Audit Read-Only First (`0` Writes):** Run `nomos xray .` and report the Day-0 `AI Hangover Score` (`0-100`, `Grade A-F`) and top 3 structural hotspots to the user.
3. **Default to Non-Breaking Branch Guard (`nomos init`):** Run `nomos init` to enable `isolation_mode: "branch"`, auto-freeze existing legacy debt in `nomos.baseline.json` so zero untouched legacy files fail, and wire native hooks for installed agents (use `nomos init --local` if the user wants a stealth `.git/info/exclude` trial with untouched `git status`). **Never run `nomos init --worktrees` on Day 0 unless the user explicitly requests multi-agent worktree isolation.**
4. **Operate Invisibly Afterward:** Tell the user setup is complete and their workflow stays unchanged on `feat/*` branches. Resolve any future `nomos verify` or hook rejections yourself without weakening tests (`t.Skip`, deleted assertions, `// TODO` stubs) and never ask the human to run `nomos` CLI commands manually.

## Quickstart & Progressive Onboarding

```bash
curl -fsSL https://sophialabs.ca/install | bash
nomos xray .              # 5-second read-only AI Hangover Score & structural hotspot audit across 11 languages
nomos init                # Default: Branch Guard + brownfield nomos.baseline.json ratchet + auto-detected agent hooks
nomos init --local        # Optional: zero-footprint stealth trial tracked only in .git/info/exclude
nomos init --ci           # Optional: scaffolds offline GitHub Actions (SARIF 2.1.0) & GitLab CI verification workflows
nomos init --worktrees    # Optional scale-up: isolated git worktrees & formal INT/SUB task lifecycle
```

## Core Capabilities (100% Local Static Go Binary)

- **Default Invisible Branch Guard (`isolation_mode: "branch"`):** Blocks direct commits on `main` and config tampering while plain `git commit` on `feat/*` branches runs 42 AST gates and distills lessons automatically.
- **42 Polyglot Anti-Reward-Hacking AST Quality Gates (`nomos verify`):** Evaluates 42 compiled Go, Tree-sitter `.scm`, and WASM gates across 11 languages (Go, TypeScript/Svelte, Python, Rust, Ruby, C/C++, Java, Kotlin, C#) in ~460ms (~24ms single-file) with zero LLM judge tokens.
- **~4ms Pre-Tool Security Airlock & Loop Breaker (`nomos hook`):** Blocks credential reads (`~/.ssh`, `~/.aws`, `~/.kube`), cloud metadata SSRF, unverified "tests pass" claims, and 3-strike tool loops.
- **Diff-Scoped Mutation Proofs (`nomos verify --pr --mutate-diff`):** Mutates newly added conditionals and return values across Go, TypeScript/JS, and Python to reject tautological unit tests before merge.
- **Receipt-Gated Episodic Memory (`nomos mem` / `nomos mcp`):** Persists verified `pitfall` and `pattern` lessons in pure-Go SQLite WAL (`mneme.db`) with `<50ms` recall and read-only JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP exposure.
- **Optional Hermetic Git Worktrees & Collision Radar (`nomos init --worktrees`):** Provisions isolated `worktrees/<repo>-<task>` sandboxes (`nomos task chore | start | sync`), SHA-256 Git Notes receipts, and exported AST symbol collision detection (`MTPO` / `nomos physics`).

## Canonical CLI Surface

- **One-Time Setup & On-Demand Audit:**
  - `nomos xray [path] [--markdown] [--sarif]` - Read-only structural complexity, clone, monolith, stub, CWE sink, and SARIF 2.1.0 health scan.
  - `nomos init [--local] [--ci] [--worktrees]` - Scaffolds Branch Guard (`nomos.yaml`), brownfield `nomos.baseline.json`, stealth `.git/info/exclude` trials, CI workflows, and agent hooks.
- **Agent-Driven Verification & Memory (Run Automatically by Hooks / Agents):**
  - `nomos verify [--pr --mutate-diff] [--sarif] [--impact]` - Evaluates all 42 Definition of Done gates, optional diff mutation proofs, SARIF 2.1.0, and 1-hop AST blast radius.
  - `nomos mem recall "<query>" [-A]` - Searches local or cross-repository verified episodic lessons.
  - `nomos status` - Displays active governance mode, branch/worktree state, and baseline posture.
  - `nomos --help-agent` - Reveals internal agent-harness RPCs (`handshake`, `hook`, `capabilities`, `directive`, `physics`, `mcp`).
- **Optional Worktree Lifecycle (`--worktrees` Mode Only):**
  - `nomos task chore "<title>"` | `nomos task start <KEY> --edit` | `nomos task sync <KEY> -m "<summary>"`
